Commentary.Commentary: Shikhar Dhawan is caught downstairs for a chat. He says they started a bit slow but then took off after that. Credits Rohit for the way he batted. On Oshane Thomas, he smirks and says that thankfully he didn't play on this time. On the pitch and stadium he mentions that it is one of the best in the world. Says that Windies are going to come hard at them and he hopes India wins the game.

Not a lot to write about the Windies bowlers. They started well but could not continue. Khary Pierre had a day to forget. The skipper too was taken to the cleaners. Keemo Paul was good with the ball but he was poor in the field. Had he taken Dhawan early on, it could have made a big difference. Now though they have to put all that behind and now try and chase this target down. It is going to be very tough but someone from their team will have to put in a brilliant performance. Will they do so? We will find out but first, Dhawan is up for an interview.

The pair stitched a massive 123-run stand before the southpaw was dismissed a few runs short of his half ton. Pant too followed him shortly but Rohit Sharma continued. Lokesh Rahul's excellent cameo did not let the pressure get to him and the two added a quickfire 62-run stand in just 28 balls. To add to that, India managed to smash 66 in the last 5 with the hit-man getting to his ton.

Another Rohit Sharma show is what we witnessed here. And when he gets going India are more-or-less going to post a massive score on the board. They have done so, a daunting 196 is what the Windies need to chase down. After electing to bowl, the visitors started off really well initially but once Rohit and Dhawan got their eye in, the runs started to come at ease. The ball then started to find the fence quite regularly.
No 200, only a single to finish. This is eased down to long off for a run. A massive last over. 20 from it and INDIA FINISH WITH 195/2!
SIX! This just keeps getting better for India. Right in the arc of Rohit Sharma. Full and on middle, he tonks it over the sightscreen for another biggie. Another big hit will see the 200 come up.

FOUR! Poor from Brathwaite. He just could not control his aggression. Bowls a brilliant yorker which is jammed out towards him. He has a needless shy at the striker's end. It is a wild throw. The keeper had no chance and it goes to the third man fence. Third boundary in a row.

100 for Rohit Sharma. He gets there with back-to-back boundaries. Pumps his fist and then raises his bat to acknowledge the applause by the crowd. What an innings from the opener. It is his fourth in this format and now he sits at the top of the pile with the most no. of T20I tons. Talk about leading from the front. Single handedly has taken India to a huge score. He plays the paddle, connects well and hits it over short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! EDGY! But Rohit will take it. Moves onto 96. A full toss outside off, he swings, the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fence.
Carlos who is going to bowl the last, starts off with a very full ball. It is hit down to long on for a run. The crowd erupts as it is Rohit who comes on strike.
Only a run to end! Just 6 from the penultimate over. Brilliant. Rahul shuffles across and Paul bowls it outside off, it is hit towards covers for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. A dot, gold dust at this stage.

In the air... dropped! Pollard has dropped it. A tough chance but the big man normally gobbles them up. Rahul mistimes it in the air towards long on. Pollard there comes running in, puts in a dive and tries to catch but the ball does not stay in his hands. A couple taken.
Goes for the reverse but misses. These are delightful to watch when they come off but ugly when they don't. Not sure if he needs to hit that when he hits them so well in front of the wicket.
Slower and fuller in length. Rahul smashes it through covers. It is a little too close to the sweeper so only a couple from it.
Full on middle, this is flicked through mid-wicket. Rohit wants the second but is sent back as the fielder was quick to the ball.
Keemo Paul is back on.
Brings in the innovation and brings out the reverse sweep. Gets a top edge towards third man. A couple taken. Another expensive over, 21 from it. 31 in 12 for 200.
SIX! 200 is very much possible now! Stands tall and hits it over the bowler' head. It is right off the middle so it carries all the way.
Another wide! Maybe this was just not a good move. Full and outside off, wided.
Fried wide outside off, wided.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! 10 from the last two balls! A full toss outside off, Rohit drives it square on the off side and a boundary results. He is into the 90s.
SIX! A lot of bottom hand in that shot. Rohit dances down the track, he was not to the pitch of the ball but still goes ahead with the shot and grabs maximum.
Tosses it up outside off, Rohit tries to hit it through the off side but chops it towards the keeper.
12 from the over! A full toss is eased down to long off for a run.

In the air... but safe! A low full toss and Rahul tries to paddle. The ball hits his top edge and then onto the helmet. It lobs towards short fine leg. The fielder there does nto get to it. A run taken.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Pierced the gap to perfection. Short and outside off, he created the room for himself and then cuts it through backward point for a boundary. 10 from the first four balls.
FOUR! This is pure class! Waited for the slower ball and then lifts it over the cover fielder. No one in the deep and a boundary results.
Another single as it is worked towards deep mid-wicket.
Fuller in length on middle, Rahul mistimes it towards long on and a run is taken.
Carlos Brathwaite is back on.
It is quicker and on off, Rahul guides it towards short third man for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Rohit again cuts it towards point, this time for a run.
Slower through the air on off, Sharma guides it to point.
Uses his feet and hits it down to long on for a run.
Lokesh Rahul is the new man in.

OUT! Pant's stay is a short one. His promotion up the order does not work. Not sure if this was needed, especially having got a boundary of the first ball. He tries to find the fence again with a slog sweep, does not get the desired elevation and it goes flat towards Hetmyer at deep mid-wicket who takes it. So two quick wickets for Windies and that is the only way they can contain the Indian run rate.
FOUR! Once again an over starts with a boundary! It is full and on the pads, Pany whips it through mid-wicket and into the fence. That was hit with a lot of power.
Just six from the over despite going for a boundary early. Excellent comeback. Pant guides this through point for a run.
Three dots after going for 5 of the first two balls. Good change in length, a bumper ducked under.
On a length and around off, Pant tries to defend but gets an inside edge on the leg side.
Fuller on off, stroked to mid off.

Direct hit needed but missed! To add to that the batsmen run an overthrow. The slower ball, surprises Rohit. He guides it towards point. Allen there has a shy at the non-striker's end as Pant is way out of his crease. The ball misses the stumps, beats the fielder backing up but Pollard from long on does well and stops it with a dive.

FOUR! Poor ball to begin his new spell. Short and outside off, Rohit has ample of time to guide it over point. Just uses the pace and a boundary results. Pressure on the bowler as a boundary is hit early in the over.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in. Oshane Thomas is back on.

OUT! Finally a wicket for the visitors. Fuller ball on off, Dhawan gets low and sweeps it towards backward square leg. Pooran covers ground to his left, dives and then takes it with one hand. The ball sticks and Windies get their breakthrough. A massive opening stand for India comes to an end and the platform is laid for the others to finish it off.
Wide! Short ball down leg. Dhawan leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide.
Hit uppishly over mid-wicket for a brace.
Sees Dhawan charging down the wicket and bowls this flatter on leg. Dhawan pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Hit hard over the bowler's head to long off for just one.
SIX! Another one! Dealing in boundaries. This one is fuller on off, Rohit slogs it over mid-wicket for back-to-back sixes.
SIX! Big hit! Six on every stadium. Flatter ball on off, Rohit sweeps this over mid-wicket for a monster hit.
Allen to continue.
The batsman has lofted it over covers. They pick up a single. 11 from the over, India needed this as they had slowed down a little.
EDGY RUNS! Luck favoring India. He tries to go over leg but the ball takes the top edge and goes towards third man. A couple taken.
Dhawan now goes for the slog but can't find the gap. It is towards mid on for another single.
Slower ball on middle, it is driven down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball with third man up! It is short and outside off, easy for Rohit he cuts it through point and the ball races away. 100 up for India and they have all ten wickets in hand.

50 for Rohit Sharma! Another excellent innings by the Indian opener and he is not done yet. If he stays till the end, India will surely score a big total. It is his 16th in this format. He works this through mid-wicket. Once again the power on the shot and the placement is perfect. Two taken.
Slower through the air on middle, Dhawan is going way too hard at the deliveries. It takes an inside edge towards short fine leg. A dot to end. India have slowed down here.
Plays the reverse sweep nicely and takes two.
Slower and on the pads, this one stays a touch low. It is pushed towards mid-wicket.
Swing and a miss! This is fired outside off, Dhawan looks to target cow corner but does not connect.
A single to follow up the boundary as this is timed through covers.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot that! Rohit dances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and beats the dive of the fielder at long on. Ideal start to this over.
Nope! It is a dot! A good over by Paul and Windies have bowled 2 good consecutive overs. Slower ball on off, Dhawan finds the man at covers.
A couple now but it is still a good over. Dhawan jams the yorker out through cover-point for a brace. Will the extra ball cost Paul here?
Slower ball, a little too wide outside off, the batsman lets it be. Wided.
The fourth is also a good one as it is hit towards sweeper cover for a run.
The seam up ball and it is outside off, Rohit fails to put bat on ball. A good first three balls from Keemo.
In the air... but on the bounce! Slower ball outside off, Dhawan hits it uppishly towards long off but well short of him. A run taken.
A dipping slower ball on off, it is hit down to long off for a run.
Keemo Paul is back on.
Fires a full toss on the pads, Rohit hits it down to long off for another single. Allen has done a decent job so far. He has given only 10 in his 2.
This is hit very hard down to long on but just for a run.
On the shorter side, the batter pushes it down to long on for a run.
Nudges it on the leg side and gives the strike over to the man who is striking the ball really well.
Slower through the air outside off, Dhawan goes very hard at it and ends up chopping it back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle, it is pushed down to long on for a run.
Length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side for one. 14 runs off the over.
FOUR! Pure power! Carlos digs it in short outside off, Rohit rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball races to the boundary. Nobody moved.
Full in line of the stumps, Rohit shows respect.
SIX! Third six for Rohit. Length ball down leg. Rohit waits for it and then pulls it over fine leg for half a dozen. Nicely done.
Another pull short. This time straight to the fielder at cow corner. One run.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Keemo makes a meal of it. Short ball on middle, Dhawan pulls it high over square leg. It has more height than distance. Keemo in the deep settles under it but cannot hold onto it. And to his dismay, the ball touches the ropes.
Makes room and then guides it through point for a run.
The batsman guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bizarre from Allen, that was quite short of him. He should have known that bounced.

JUST SHORT! This is tossed up around off, Rohit checks his shot and ends up hitting it uppishly towards the bowler. He dives forward and collects the ball. He is not sure if it has carried or not. The umpires have a chat and then take it upstairs. Replays show that it has bounced before the bowler's hands.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
Flatter on off, Dhawan pushes it to covers.
On the pads, it is flicked towards deep square leg. They run the first one hard, put pressure on the fielder. He fumbles and concedes an extra run.
Fabian Allen is into the attack now.
Another slower ball and on the body of the batsman. He pushes it down to long on for a run.
Another back of a length ball on middle, Rohit pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
A poor ball, short and down the leg side. Dhawan pulls but not fine enough. Finds fine leg and only a run.
Nicely played! Dhawan dances down the track and punches it through covers and takes two.
Slower ball and on a length. It is worked around the corner for a single.
Down the leg side and it has been wided. The umpire did take his time to give the decision but then stretches his hands.
Back of a length on off, it is pushed through covers for a run. 1000 T20I runs for Dhawan. He is the 6th Indian to do so. 50 up for the Indians.
Carlos Brathwaite is into the attack.
A single to end the Powerplay as Dhawan eases it through mid on. India will be the happier of the two after the first six. They got off to a cautious start but now are 49 for 0.
A dot! A rarity in the last few overs! Quicker and on off, Dhawan pushes it to mid off.
Loopy ball on off, Rohit Sharma times it towards long off for a run.
Wide! Pressure getting to the bowler here. He fires it down the leg side. The keeper fails to collect, it rolls towards the off side and a run is taken.
Follows it up with a single as it is driven to long off.

SIX! Another excellent shot! Second maximum of the innings and both have come from the blade of Rohit Sharma. Tossed up around middle, he knows the ball is not going to turn so he lifts it over the long on fence.
Uses his feet but the bowler slows it up and bowls it on the pads, Dhawan flicks it but straight to deep mid-wicket. Only a run.
17 from the over! A single to end as Dhawan guides it down to third man. India needed this big over as they were going nowhere in the Powerplay.
FOUR! This time he finds the gap! It is caressed through the off side and the ball races away to the cover boundary.
Crisp! This has been creamed but to the man at covers.

FOUR! You bet. He is too good to miss out twice. This has raced to the fence. Expected it to be a short one and got it. Dhawan pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. This is already a very expensive over.
Thomas has overstepped here! Second Free Hit in the innings. This is guided down to third man for a single. Once again Dhawan is on strike. Can he make use of this one?

SIX! All the way! Top shot! He just had to time that and he did exactly that. Full and on the stumps, Rohit makes room and then lofts it over the bowler's head. It carries all the way. India getting a move on now.
A full toss on middle, Rohit Sharma is a little too late on his shot and he mistimes it to mid on.
A single to end! 9 from the over! A good comeback from the bowler after going for a boundary on the first ball. This is fired full on middle, Sharma jams it out towards square leg for a single.
Uses his feet a little early. Pierre fires it on the pads. Rohit works it towards short fine leg. He wants a run but is sent back and rightly so.
Flatter and on off, Dhawan off the back foot pushes it towards mid off for a quick run.
Slower through the air on middle, Dhawan places it nicely. The weight on the shot is perfect and the batsmen get two.
Now the Windies push the mid off back and Rohit eases it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Up and over! Welcome into the attack. This is tossed up on off, too easy for Rohit Sharma. He lofts it over mid off for the first boundary tonight.
Khary Pierre is into the attack.
Lovely stuff! Short and rising on the batsman Dhawan is on his toes as he tries to defend it. A dot to end another good over by Thomas, India off to a watchful start here.
First signs of intent against Thomas but once again it is only a single. Rohit makes room and tries to cut but gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A run taken.
Another single! Dhawan tries to nudge it on the leg side but the ball takes the inside edge and hits the boot. Rolls towards mid off for a run.
Not easy to get the big guy away! He bowls it on the shorter side and closer to the off pole. Dhawan goes for the cut but ends up chopping it to point.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit guides it down to third man for a run. They are quite cautious while playing Oshane.
Another quick single! When boundaries are hard to come by, rotation of strike is very important. Dhawan drops this on the off side and takes a run.
Uses his feet but does not quite get under the delivery. He times it towards mid off for another run. So singles is all India have to be content with at the moment.
Nothing from the Free Hit! A well disguised slower ball outside off, Dhawan is way too early in his heave and misses.

NO BALL! Just not acceptable in this version of the game. Keemo has overstepped and by some margin. It is bowled on a back of a length on off, Rohit pushes it towards mid off for a single. Free Hit coming up.
A little too short and wide outside off, Rohit fails to put it away as he cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Fuller again and on middle, Rohit tries to go over mid-wicket. The ball though goes off the inner half towards deep square leg for a run.
Fuller again and on middle, Rohit tries to go over mid-wicket. The ball though goes off the inner half towards deep square leg for a run. Rohit is now off the mark.
Down the leg side, Rohit tries to help it on its way but fails to do so. It has been wided.
He starts off with a fuller length ball, gets it to shape back in a touch. Dhawan works it towards wide mid for a run. India and Dhawan are underway.
Keemo Paul to bowl from the other end.
Yes, a maiden to begin with! Slightly shorter in length around off, Rohit pushes it to mid off.
Top stuff! Hits the length again and lands it on the stumps. Not letting the batsman free his arms. Rohit keeps it out. Can he start with a maiden?
Make that 4 as this is another back of a length delivery closer to the off pole. Rohit mistimes it to covers.
Back of a length and closer to the off pole. Rohit guides it towards point. Three dots to begin with.
Rohit wants another sighter as he makes another leave to a ball outside off.
A good start by the tall pacer. He lands it on a length and on the 5th stump channel. Rohit Sharma shoulders arms. The opener wants a sighter.

We are all set for the action to begin. Out come the Windies players and they are followed by the Indian openers, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. Oshane Thomas will start the proceedings for the visitors. Here we go...

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma, says they were looking to bowl first. Adds further it is the first game here, so he is not sure how the pitch will play. Reckons there is good grass covering so it should hold up well. Mentions the dew will be there in both the innings. Informs there is one change as Kumar comes in for Yadav. Ends by saying the decision was not easy but Kumar has been their no. 1 bowler for a long time and his experience will play a part.

Windies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite, says it is a new stadium and he is not sure what the wicket will do and hence wants to chase. Mentions the dew plays a big factor in his decision. Informs there is one change as Nicholas Pooran comes in for Rovman Powell.
Toss - Brathwaite calls it right and they elect to field first.

Pitch report - Murali Kartik and Sunil Gavaskar say there is fair covering of grass along with the cracks so it is difficult to predict how the wicket will play. They expect it to not change a lot as it is a T20 game. Reckon there will be some moisture under the surface and it may assist the pacers. End by saying it is a big playing surface.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd T20I between India and Windies. It's the festive season here in India and the hosts will look to wrap up the series tonight itself. They were put under pressure in the first game but then came on top eventually. Much more were expected from the Windies because of their T20 reputation but they didn't live up to it. They will look to come stronger tonight and take the series till the last game. India will want to improve their top order batting as it failed. In other news, the 'Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana' cricket stadium will be hosting its first T20I game, becoming India's 52nd international venue. Toss and team news coming your way.
